title: New text models, with routing and queue changes
summary:
Three text models joined the roster, routing and queues changed, and a semantic-cache experiment was rolled back.

Added `llama-fast-roblox`, `mistral-roblox`, and `mistral-nemo-roblox`. Several existing models changed providers or routes, including `openai-large` moving from GPT-4.1 to GPT-4o Mini. Queue concurrency changed by tier, and `gptimage` requests below Nectar tier now use flux.

AI Dream Girl Studio joined the chat projects list. Its creator uses Pollinations-generated character visuals alongside animation, voiceovers, and storytelling.

Model-specific semantic caching was merged for the text API, then reverted the same day. Text requests do not use the proposed Vectorize path to reuse responses for similar prompts.

highlights.title: Llama fast Roblox added
highlights.text: Try `llama-fast-roblox` through the text API. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=llama-fast-roblox).

highlights.title: Two Mistral Roblox options
highlights.text: The text model roster also gained `mistral-roblox` and `mistral-nemo-roblox`. [View mistral-roblox](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistral-roblox).
